correctness.rationale: The frozen proof FAILS: each of the v conic-line-line triples is still a line-only double point; frozen RESULT lines 51–66 and its checker put 21−3u−v in the line inequality instead of 21−3u. The corrected inequality gives only 5≤u≤6, and six incidence cases survive the old geometric premises. The completed replacement proves the same conclusion: Gałecka's bounds, Tjurina and Bézout give n=t−1, s=12−t, 1≤t≤4; the corrected Hirzebruch bound and pair counts reduce to seven refined patterns. With one tangent, central symmetry exchanging two three-line pencils cannot induce an involution on the conic with just one fixed point. With two, two tangents would use the same unique matching on a four-vertex path. With three, the forced on-conic triangle violates the degree-two cycle constraint when b=2; when b=3 the normalized three pair points force equal nonzero dual off-diagonal entries but do not satisfy the primal equation. With four, two diagonal secants intersect off the conic and all tangents, ultimately forcing all three secants to be diagonals and v=0, contrary to v=2. The explicit adjugate verifies all coordinate exclusions over C. The corrected script was replayed with python3 /workspace/repairs/5/verify_constraints.py and returned the seven asserted profiles; it checks arithmetic only.
residual_risks: The numerical script is not a geometric decision procedure or formal verification; the two published inequalities are used as theorems.
